messages:
alex: Hey team — need to push a small canary hotfix to prod (v2026.03.18-pin-12 -> v2026.03.18-pin-12-hotfix). No one with deploy role is online. Can we get a temporary deploy grant for @maria? No DB migrations, just a cache eviction tweak. ETA to push ~10m.

deploy-bot: To grant, run: `deploy-bot grant --user @maria --roles deploy --duration 60m --reason "canary hotfix: cache eviction bug"` Audit will be recorded.

maria: I don't have my YubiKey at home right now. I only have SSO + Google Auth TOTP. Is that acceptable for a temp elevation?

ira-security: From sec side: we require 2FA via SSO at minimum. Hardware token preferred but TOTP + SSO is OK for a short emergency window. Will require approval from @release-manager and we'll cap to 30m unless release-manager extends.

release-manager: I checked the diff and the risk is low. Approving a 30m window to @maria conditional on: 1) post-deploy monitor checks active, 2) explicit rollback trigger defined.

devon: Rollback plan (copied here): if error rate >3% or p50 latency exceeds baseline by >150ms sustained for 5m, run: `release rollback --to v2026.03.18-pin-12 --strategy canary-then-full`. Also ensure job `infra/clear-cache` is NOT run simultaneously.

alex: I will kick off the grant now (using deploy-bot).

deploy-bot: grant request received for @maria. Approver required: @release-manager. Audit id: grant-20260320-abc123.

release-manager: approved. Granting 30m window. Deployment window set 12:05-12:35 UTC. @oncall please watch dashboards.

maria: starting canary deploy now. Canary group = 2% traffic. Rolling slice 1/4.

maria: quick status: logs show `ERROR: cache-evict: nil pointer at kv_store.go:88` during first scrape but it only affected a tiny subset. Metric spike +0.2% errors at 12:07 UTC.

devon: monitors look stable otherwise. If that error climbs, prepare rollback. Tag the change: `hotfix/cache-evict` in release notes.

maria: moving to 25% -> 100% now.

maria: rollout finished to 100%. p50 latency +10ms, error rate settled at 0.1%. No action required.

release-manager: Confirming closure of window. Please revoke temp grant and attach the audit to the release ticket. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Revocation request received: revoke grant-20260320-abc123. Grant revoked. Audit archived to /audit/grants/grant-20260320-abc123.log

ira-security: Noted — updating compliance log and adding blurb to the release notes about the temporary elevation (reason: emergency canary hotfix). If you rely on temp grants often, we need to schedule a short runbook review.

maria: thanks all — will add the short postmortem to the release ticket with the logs and rollback decision tree.

oncall: watching metrics during the window, nothing anomalous reported. Great job team.

alex: closing thread.
